claims.text: Many reviewers find the hair soft, natural-looking, and easy to install, with several planning to repurchase.
A common complaint is that the package contains less hair than expected (two packs with small bunches rather than six full packs), so buyers often need to order multiple packages.
Some reviewers say the hair does not match the picture and call it false advertising or thin.
Several reviewers report the hair gets dry and tangles easily, sometimes right after install.
Splitting the bundles in two is a popular tip that reviewers say makes the hair look more natural and cover the whole head.
